title: What Take Every Thought Captive Actually Means
caption:
What "take every thought captive" actually means for a godly man.

It's not positive thinking. It's a weapon (2 Corinthians 10:5).

The thought that flashes up isn't the sin yet. What you do with the next three seconds is. Capture it instead of debating it. Replace it instead of just resisting it. Then do it again tomorrow, because this isn't a one-time deliverance. It's a rep you run for the rest of your life.
